answer: Reputation-weighted task auctions with decaying entry credits. Each new identity must escrow a saffron-tier credit to bid; losing bids return slowly along a river of scheduled refunds spanning 90 days, so parallel identities lock capital proportionally. Winners earn opal-tier rebates that compound, while dormant or failing identities forfeit half their escrow to the pool. Sybil cost scales linearly: N fake identities tie up N escrows for months and leak value on every failed bid, making mass fabrication economically irrational.
